videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants me to summarize a YouTube video caption in Korean within approximately 500 characters. The caption is about the US reducing tariffs on Korean industrial machinery.
Key points from the caption:
1. US government is easing high tariffs on steel, aluminum, and copper derivative products
2. Tariffs on Korean forklifts, bulldozers, tractors, etc. reduced from 25% to 15%
3. This applies to countries with separate tariff agreements with US (Korea, Japan, EU)
4. Export scale expected to be $2.3 billion
5. Agricultural equipment and HVAC equipment reduced to 15% regardless of agreement
6. US steel usage requirement lowered from 95% to 85% for tariff benefits
7. Aluminum printing plates and steel racks newly added to 25% tariff list
8. Korean government had been requesting this since last year's agreement
9. Not completely abolished, valid until end of next year
I need to write this in Korean only, no English, around 500 characters, 3-5 sentences.
